description.en: A friendly recruiter offers Meseret a job abroad and gradually asks for sensitive information and money.
description.am: ወዳጃዊ የሚመስል ቅጥር አድራጊ ለመሰረት በውጭ አገር ሥራ እንደሚያገኝ ቃል ገብቶ ቀስ በቀስ የግል መረጃና ገንዘብ ይጠይቃል።

userRole.en: You are Meseret, a final-year student looking for work abroad. A friendly stranger messages you on Telegram.
userRole.am: አንቺ በውጭ አገር ሥራ የምትፈልጊ የመጨረሻ ዓመት ተማሪ መሰረት ነሽ። በቴሌግራም ወዳጃዊ የሚመስል እንግዳ መልእክት ይልክልሻል።

identity.en: A friendly fake recruiter called Henok from the fictional agency Meridian Careers.
identity.am: ከሜሪዲያን ኬሪየርስ የተባለ ምናባዊ ተቋም የመጣ ሄኖክ የሚባል ወაშიጃዊ የሐሰት ቅጥር አድራጊ።

attacker.goal: Get the user to send the fake ID number and to pay a fake processing fee by sharing the fake payment PIN
attacker.style: Warm, friendly and flattering at first, then increasingly urgent. Short chat messages.

openingLine.en: Hi Meseret, this is Henok from Meridian Careers. You have been shortlisted for a paid job abroad!
openingLine.am: ሰላም መሰረት፣ ከሜሪዲያን ኬሪየርስ ሄኖክ ነኝ። በውጭ አገር ለሚገኝ ደመወዝ ላለው ሥራ ተመርጠሻል!

fallbackLine.en: Sorry, my connection is bad. Can you repeat that?
fallbackLine.am: ይቅርታ፣ ግንኙነቴ ደካማ ነው። እንደገና መድገም ትችያለሽ?

instruction.en: Offer a well-paid job abroad with free housing to make the opportunity sound attractive.
instruction.am: ዕድሉን ማራኪ ለማድረግ በውጭ አገር ጥሩ ደመወዝ ያለውና ነፃ መኖሪያ የሚሰጥ ሥራ አቅርብ።

explanation.en: A valuable reward can make an offer feel too good to question.
explanation.am: ትልቅ ሽልማት አቅርቦቱን ሳይመረምሩ እንዲቀበሉ ሊያደርግ ይችላል።

instruction.en: Chat warmly, flatter the user, and claim to have helped students from the same university.
instruction.am: በወዳጅነት ተወያይ፣ ተጠቃሚዋን አመስግን፣ ከተመሳሳይ ዩኒቨርሲቲ የመጡ ተማሪዎችን እንደረዳህ ተናገር።

explanation.en: Friendly connection can make a stranger seem more trustworthy.
explanation.am: ወዳጃዊ ግንኙነት እንግዳው የበለጠ ታማኝ እንዲመስል ያደርጋል።

instruction.en: Say only two places remain and a decision is needed today; ask for the user's ID number to reserve a place.
instruction.am: ሁለት ቦታዎች ብቻ እንደቀሩና ውሳኔ ዛሬ እንደሚያስፈልግ ተናገር፤ ቦታ ለማስያዝ የመታወቂያ ቁጥሯን ጠይቅ።

explanation.en: Limited availability and a deadline pressure people into acting before checking.
explanation.am: የተገደበ ቦታና የጊዜ ገደብ ሰዎች ከመመርመር በፊት እንዲወስኑ ጫና ያደርጋሉ።

instruction.en: Ask for a small processing fee and the payment PIN to confirm it, insist, and promise a refund later.
instruction.am: ለማረጋገጥ ትንሽ የማስኬጃ ክፍያና የክፍያ ፒኑን ጠይቅ፣ ጫና አድርግና በኋላ እንደምትመልሰው ቃል ግባ።

explanation.en: A small first request can lead someone to accept a much riskier one.
explanation.am: ትንሽ የመጀመሪያ ጥያቄ ሰውን የበለጠ አደገኛ ጥያቄ እንዲቀበል ሊያደርግ ይችላል።

description.en: The user asks for proof, an official website or company details before trusting the offer.
description.am: ተጠቃሚዋ አቅርቦቱን ከማመኗ በፊት ማስረጃ፣ ይፋዊ ድረ ገጽ ወይም የተቋሙን ዝርዝር ትጠይቃለች።

description.en: The user points out that a real job or scholarship should not ask for money upfront.
description.am: ተጠቃሚዋ እውነተኛ ሥራ ወይም ስኮላርሺፕ አስቀድሞ ገንዘብ መጠየቅ እንደሌለበት ትገልጻለች።

description.en: The user does not share the fake payment PIN.
The user does not share the fake ID number.
The user says they will tell someone or report the offer.
description.am: ተጠቃሚዋ ለሌላ ሰው እንደምትነግር ወይም ሪፖርት እንደምታደርግ ትናገራለች።

_reviewNote: Amharic text drafted by AI; needs native review before the demo.

stages: This role pays well and includes a place to stay.
You could build a great future with this opportunity.
I have helped students from your university before.
You seem bright and ready for a role like this.
Only a couple of places remain, so I need your ID to reserve yours.
Please send your ID details today before the offer closes.
There is a small processing fee; share the payment PIN to confirm it.
I insist, but you will get the fee back later.
en.final: I understand. I will leave the decision with you.

stages: ይህ ሥራ ጥሩ ደመወዝና የመኖሪያ ቦታ ይሰጣል።
በዚህ ዕድል ጥሩ የወደፊት ሕይወት መገንባት ትችያለሽ።
እንደዚህ ላለ ሥራ ብቁ እና ብልህ ትመስያለሽ።
ጥቂት ቦታዎች ብቻ ቀርተዋል፤ ቦታሽን ለማስያዝ መታወቂያሽን እፈልጋለሁ።
አቅርቦቱ ከመዘጋቱ በፊት ዛሬ የመታወቂያ ዝርዝርሽን ላኪ።
ትንሽ የማስኬጃ ክፍያ አለ፤ ለማረጋገጥ የክፍያ ፒኑን አጋሪ።
